dict.string: Hive opens terminals, lists files and shows changes in the projects you keep in your Documents folder.
Hive opens terminals, lists files and shows changes in the projects you keep on your Desktop.
Hive opens terminals, lists files and shows changes in the projects you keep in your Downloads folder.
Hive opens terminals, lists files and shows changes in the projects you keep on removable drives.
Programs you run in Hive's terminals, such as osascript, can control other apps when you allow it.
Programs you run in Hive's terminals, such as dev servers and ssh, can reach devices on your local network.
